cohort: The study included 33 neurologically impaired children, with a median age of 4.9 years (8 months-17 years), who underwent initial gastrostomy to gastrojejunal tube conversion or gastrojejunal tube replacement in a tertiary paediatric surgical centre between January 2015 and June 2018.
finding: Gastrojejunal tube feeding is an effective and safe method for managing children with foregut dysmotility, and many patients do not require permanent jejunal feeding, highlighting the reversibility of this method.
